evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~412→418 °C, physically implausible versus column temperatures 44–62 °C at 200 mbar; drifts monotonically upward
Column profile flat and stable (61.3→44.4 °C), no boil-up-driven change consistent with a 418 °C reboiler
Reflux flow near zero (0.05–0.5 L/h) and erratic while FYI702 reports a steady ratio ~3.6–4.6, inconsistent with measured FT703/FT704

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading (second TC or wall/bath sensor) and heater power setpoint to confirm T701 sensor drift versus real overheating; also raw basis of FYI702 ratio computation.
